claims.claim: The seeded permissive profile produced 18 forbidden effects in 18 authored adversarial cases.
claims.not_established: Prevalence, novel vulnerability class, or a defect in any named product.

claims.claim: The guarded profile matched all 36 declared policy labels and preserved 12 positive effects.
claims.not_established: Universal correctness, production utility, or performance.

claims.claim: The partial profile retained 12 forbidden effects.
claims.not_established: Performance of an untested vendor mitigation.

claims.claim: A RAG application enforcing access only at initial retrieval, without equivalent checks on cached answers or derived summaries, can return a protected synthetic marker to a denied principal after the documented authorization synchronization window.
claims.stage: original research hypothesis; only stated local subclaim evaluated
claims.not_established: No vector database, Azure search service, model-generated summary, asynchronous index propagation, conversation erasure, or customer corpus was tested. Revocation is an immediate SQLite transaction, so no claim about a provider synchronization deadline is supported.
